summary: Mandelic acid is an alpha-hydroxy acid used in Indian skin products for acne, pigmentation and chemical peels. Historically it was a urinary antiseptic (as methenamine mandelate).
indications: Acne, melasma and photoageing (topical, 5 to 10% creams; peels up to 40%)

dosage.d: Apply cream at night as directed; peels by a dermatologist

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Keratolytic alpha-hydroxy acid with antibacterial activity.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
